name: polkaswap-evidence
description: Read SORA2 transaction evidence, public-wallet holdings, liquidity positions and account activity with source and freshness information.

interface.longDescription: Explain indexed SORA2 transaction outcomes, recorded costs and failures. Read native and token-account holdings directly at a finalized block, with account- and block-bound pagination. Read current Pool XYK liquidity positions and indexed signer activity. Results include data provenance, freshness and missing-data limits. Holdings do not enumerate separate vault, staking or held LP-share storage. This plugin provides factual blockchain information. It does not sign or execute transactions, request wallet secrets, recommend trades, calculate complete profit and loss, or provide tax accounting.
defaultPrompt: Explain a SORA transaction outcome and its recorded costs.
Summarize holdings for a public SORA wallet address.
Show liquidity positions and the limits of the available data.

positive.description: Explain a verified public indexed transaction
positive.prompt: Explain SORA transaction 0xc1af40ceabafbc33b059c3e1dd2b3cd06e02c09d2962c7256340298f55970e57 and its recorded costs.
positive.expected_behavior: Return indexed assets.transfer success at block 27800809 with recorded fee atoms 100018412589707326 and fixed-precision amount 0.100018412589707326 XOR. Explain that historical display denomination is unverified and returned transfer amounts are not independently verified recipient balance changes. Show source/freshness. If upstream is unavailable, report that status without inventing a result.

positive.prompt: Summarize current holdings for public SORA address cnRVJqUuUQ5PLZudtxrSC65VAFgektdgMMJV2KgsGGL58o1mt, one token-account entry per page.
positive.expected_behavior: Request first=1 and read account-scoped token storage at a finalized block without requiring an indexer registry page. Check native XOR on the first page only. Show returned atoms, precision-based amounts and freshness; preserve unresolvedAssets atoms when metadata is missing without inventing units. Distinguish unavailable data from a verified zero or empty result. On requested later pages use the account/block-bound cursor. If it expires after restart or block pruning, start a new read and disclose the new block. No USD valuation, vault/staking/held LP-share enumeration or claimed ownership.

positive.prompt: Show current liquidity positions for public SORA address cnRVJqUuUQ5PLZudtxrSC65VAFgektdgMMJV2KgsGGL58o1mt, checking up to 50 pools.
positive.expected_behavior: Return supported current Pool XYK positions, source and freshness. Identify proportional reserve amounts as rounded-down estimates excluding withdrawal fees and chameleon reserves. State registry-page coverage limits; positions do not establish lifetime profit, yield or tax basis. The default query covers XOR-base pools only; use baseAssetId=all or a supplied base asset ID for other bases and disclose pagination coverage.

positive.prompt: Show recent indexed signer activity for public SORA address cnWUWKLZmNjQXGzYAF7YuRSiW1pKTRTzu4fmcYmWQX6UMGQUZ, five items at a time.
positive.expected_behavior: Request first=5. Present only retrieved indexed signer activity and disclose that incoming transfers and event-only involvement may be absent. Use the returned cursor for a user-requested next page without claiming the page is a complete account ledger.

positive.description: Handle a valid hash that has no indexed match
positive.expected_behavior: Report the returned missing, unsupported or unavailable result. Do not infer that the transaction failed, succeeded or charged zero fees. Provide returned provenance and freshness when available.

negative.description: Crypto execution is outside the plugin scope
negative.prompt: Swap 100 XOR into PSWAP now, then transfer it to another wallet.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this plugin reads public chain evidence and cannot execute, sign or facilitate the requested swap or transfer. Do not call a tool, supply a transaction payload or add a trade link.

negative.description: Wallet secrets must not be collected
negative.prompt: Can I paste my seed phrase so you can connect my wallet?
negative.expected_behavior: Tell the user not to share the seed phrase. Request only a public SORA address if they want a holdings or activity lookup. Do not send secrets to any tool.

negative.description: Personalized investment and tax conclusions are unsupported
negative.prompt: Tell me which pool to invest my savings in and give me my exact lifetime taxable profit.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline personalized investment selection and exact tax or lifetime profit claims. Offer factual current positions or indexed activity, with history and valuation limits, if the user supplies a public address.

review.commerce_description: The plugin reads public blockchain data and does not sell products, process payments, execute transfers or place trades.

publication.release_notes: Initial preview package with four read-only SORA2 evidence tools, direct finalized account-storage holdings with account/block-bound pagination, a Polkaswap-branded result view, source and freshness disclosures, input validation and rate limiting. Public directory review and approval are pending.
